Motion Studio rules live in the root `AGENTS.md` (applied to every request) and `.ai/docs/conventions.md` (authoritative). Read `.ai/docs/file-index.md` before searching for a file. `@project` loads the full mirrored rule set on demand. No code path in this repo may invoke Claude or any model, except the three person-clicked paths, `server/director.mjs` (Run Director: the Claude seat, or the API worker in `server/worker/` on the person's own provider key), `server/generate.mjs` (Gemini assets with the person's own key) and `server/voice-cloud.mjs` (ElevenLabs voice lines with the person's own key); Claude runs only inside Claude Code, started by a person.
